title: test_clearance's gated-crossing tooth reads the commons beside the code at the stones lane
intention: test_clearance's gated-crossing tooth crosses PROVED inside a CodeMother launched over its fixture registry, so its verdict never depends on the push state of the commons beside the code.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux: with the commons beside the cairn tree 1 commit ahead (stones harness case B), test_clearance reds at test_a_gated_crossing_can_actually_be_cleared_and_the_ticket_rides with ExitGateRed [the_stones_are_pushed]. A proof whose green is the operator's push state is a hollow green that peers lean on (Law 8).
traces_to: Law 8 (a false green gets leaned on by a peer) and RULE 1 (the judge answers in another process; only what rides the launch reaches it).
how: THE ESCAPED BRANCH: _durability_roots (inspector.py:2637) takes tk.parent as the ticket root when find_ticket hits, and _tf._TICKETS only when it misses. The tooth patched _tfile._TICKETS = _FIXTURE_TICKETS in the proof's own process, but called clear() with no inspect_wire.launch. So the judge ran in a default CodeMother whose _tf._TICKETS is the commons beside the code by __file__. There find_ticket('an-intention-declares-its-gated-hands') missed the exact name and its '*-{name}.json' glob hit CairnCommons/tickets/0354c0269ff7-an-intention-declares-its-gated-hands.json. tk.parent was the sibling commons, _repo_toplevel resolved it, and repo_truth measured it ahead 1, so ExitGateRed. The tooth's own check at test_clearance.py:1008 (_t._find_ticket in the patched proof process) cannot see the judge's process, which is why it stayed green while the judge read the live commons. FIX: lift the tooth's crossing into a helper _gated_crossing(tmp) in test_clearance.py that runs clear() and inspect_durability inside launch(berths=Path(tmp)/'no-chart-berths', ticket_store=_FIXTURE_TICKETS), the same world _cross_to_proved builds at 1727. The tooth calls it, and a new proof asserts where the lane's roots point.

clauses.claim: inside the gated-crossing tooth's launched world, no reading inspect_durability returns for its boat has a root or toplevel inside the commons beside the code; every root lies under the proof's tmp or _FIXTURE_TICKETS, and test_clearance stays green with that commons one commit ahead of its upstream
the ticket root the_stones_are_pushed reads for the tooth's boat is _FIXTURE_TICKETS.resolve()

decisions.text: D1: test_clearance.py gains _gated_crossing(tmp) -> (exc_or_None, repos). It builds the tooth's covered owner and journals exactly as the tooth does today, then runs clear(...) and transitions.inspect_durability(_OTHER_BOAT, history_path=hp)[0]['values']['repos'] inside `with launch(berths=Path(tmp)/'no-chart-berths', ticket_store=_FIXTURE_TICKETS), _owner_is(...), _fixture_journals():`. The tooth test_a_gated_crossing_can_actually_be_cleared_and_the_ticket_rides calls it in place of its bare clear(). Nothing else in the file changes.

D2: a red-first proof, one tooth per clause, PROVES {1,2}. Each tooth imports _gated_crossing from test_clearance INSIDE the tooth (absent at main, so it reds by name; never at module level). Clause 1: sibling = Path(cairn.__file__).resolve().parents[1].parent/'CairnCommons'; assert no reading's root or toplevel is under sibling.resolve(); every root is under tmp or _FIXTURE_TICKETS. Clause 2: the reading whose root is the ticket root equals _FIXTURE_TICKETS.resolve().

out: inspector.py's _durability_roots and find_ticket (the judge is right; the proof's world was wrong)

measured.saw: case B (commons beside the cairn tree at 3c6c6c3a1 one commit ahead): 14 PASS then ExitGateRed: PROVED crossing refused: cast ticket 'an-intention-declares-its-gated-hands' would close over stones that exist only on this laptop — CairnCommons is 1 commit(s) ahead of 025ca06557c757944e38dfbefeec32d101419532 [the_stones_are_pushed]. Call path test_clearance.py:994 -> clearance.py:1651 clear -> clearance.py:1552 _decide -> transitions.py:1707 emit -> transitions.py:1231 _exit_gate -> gate_class.py:88 run. Case A (only the scratch HOME's commons ahead) stayed green.
measured.how: stones harness on akiendelllinux, scratch clones under /var/tmp/stones.oqXCpW, HOME scratch, bin/cairn test over the proof, house trees guarded unchanged
